email-poll.name: Email Poll
email-poll.description: Poll email accounts for new and updated messages (gog/Gmail and IMAP), classify, and enqueue for download.
email-poll.prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes) or IMAP credentials

email-download.name: Email Download
email-download.description: Dequeue threads from email-pending and download full message bodies from Gmail.
email-download.prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes)

email-drain-updates.name: Email Drain Updates
email-drain-updates.description: Drain the email-updates queue and apply label changes (add, remove, archive, trash) via Gmail API.
email-drain-updates.prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes)

email-backfill-historical.name: Email Historical Backfill
email-backfill-historical.description: Paced Gmail backfill: each run searches one window (emailConfig.backfill.windowDays) per account, walking back until emailConfig.backfill.lookbackDays, then no-ops. Cursor in runner state (email-backfill/cursor-<email>).
email-backfill-historical.prerequisite: Gmail via gog (OAuth client or service-account mailboxes) + emailConfig.backfill (accounts, lookbackDays, windowDays) in jeeves-scripts.json (pipeline)

email-respond.name: Email Auto-reply
email-respond.description: Assistant-mailbox auto-reply: deterministically qualifies new mail to emailConfig.respond.mailbox (allowed sender, mailbox in To, DKIM, not automated, thread cap), handles each as a request from that sender in a worker session (which may decline when To is shared), replies in-thread preserving all original To/Cc/Bcc addressees, and (with emailConfig.respond.slackMirror) mirrors each sent reply to Slack (sender's DM, or a requested channel the sender belongs to).
email-respond.prerequisite: emailConfig.respond configured by the operator (mailbox + allowedSenders) in jeeves-scripts.json (pipeline); the mailbox a gmail account that can send via gog; slackMirror needs the users:read.email bot scope. Never auto-register.
